name: CLI A2A Read
statement: A developer reads messages from an A2A chat channel or direct message thread, receiving chronologically sorted messages with sender metadata. DMs are transparent -- any agent can read any thread.
successCriteria: limen a2a-read --channel 'general' returns messages from the channel
limen a2a-read --from 'agent-b' --me 'agent-a' returns DM thread messages
Each message includes id, sender, timestamp, transport, and message fields
--since filters messages after an ISO timestamp (scans up to 200 most-recent messages before filtering; engine-enforced ceiling CLAIM_QUERY_MAX_LIMIT=200)
--agent-id filters messages by sender (scans up to 200 most-recent messages before filtering; engine-enforced ceiling CLAIM_QUERY_MAX_LIMIT=200)
All stdout is valid JSON, all errors go to stderr as JSON
failureCriteria: limen a2a-read without --channel or --from crashes instead of returning CLI_NO_TARGET
limen a2a-read --channel 'x' --from 'y' crashes instead of returning CLI_DUAL_TARGET
limen a2a-read --since 'not-a-date' crashes instead of returning CLI_INVALID_TIMESTAMP
Any command outputs non-JSON to stdout
preconditions: limen init completed (~/.limen/ exists with master key and config)
